name: Bandage Roll
text: Heals 1d6+2. Also good for mummy costumes.

name: Healing Potion
text: Heals 2d4+4, scaled by floor. Tastes like cough syrup and pennies.

name: Mana Potion
text: Restores 2d4+2 MP, scaled by floor. Fizzy.

name: Gas Station Energy Drink
text: Hasted for 3 rounds. Heart rate: yes.

name: Half a Protein Bar
text: +1 STR for 5 rooms. Someone else ate the other half.

name: Canister of Laughing Gas
text: Thrown. Stuns the target for 1 round while it giggles.

name: Party Sparkler
text: Thrown. 1d4 fire damage and sets the target burning.

name: Jug of Laundry Detergent
text: Thrown. Blinds the target for 2 rounds. Spring Meadow scent.

name: Crude Pipe Bomb
text: Thrown. 3d6 fire damage to every enemy. Can open weak walls. Might go off early.

name: Gas Station Taquito
text: Heals 1d6. Has been rolling since Tuesday.

name: Teriyaki Beef Jerky
text: +1 CON for 3 rooms. Chewing takes a while.

name: Slice of Cold Pizza
text: Heals 1d6+1. Pepperoni curled into little cups of grease.

name: Bag of Gummy Worms
text: Heals 1d4. Hasted for 1 round from the sugar.

name: Trail Mix, Mostly Raisins
text: Heals 1d4+1. Someone picked out all the M&Ms.

name: Frozen Burrito, Now Thawed
text: Heals 2d4. Still frozen in the middle. Somehow.

name: String Cheese
text: Heals 1d4. Peel it like a civilized person.

name: Jar of Pickles
text: Heals 1d6. +1 to resist poison for 3 rooms. Brine is medicine.

name: Can of Baked Beans
text: Heals 2d4+2. Cold. Eaten with a key.

name: Jar of Peanut Butter
text: Heals 2d6. Spoon not included. Finger included.

name: Blue Sports Drink
text: Heals 1d6 and restores 1d4 MP. The flavor is 'blue'.

name: Bottle of Cough Syrup
text: Heals 1d8. You feel slow and warm for 2 rounds.

name: Cold Brew Concentrate
text: Hasted for 2 rounds. You can see sounds.

name: Triple Espresso Shot
text: Hasted for 4 rounds. Then your hands shake for a while.

name: Fruit Punch Electrolyte Drink
text: Restores 2d4 MP. Tastes red.

name: Greater Healing Potion
text: Heals 4d4+8, scaled by floor. Tastes like grape medicine and regret.

name: Greater Mana Potion
text: Restores 4d4+4 MP, scaled by floor. Fizzier.

name: Minor Healing Potion
text: Heals 1d4+2, scaled by floor. Mostly tap water.

name: Potion of Regeneration
text: Regenerating for 5 rounds. Your skin itches as it knits.

name: Generic Antivenom
text: Cures poison. The label is in Portuguese.

name: Redness Relief Eye Drops
text: Cures blindness. Stings like crazy.

name: Smelling Salts
text: Cures stun. Your eyes water. Your sinuses open.

name: Chalky Antacid Tablets
text: Cures poison and heals 1d4. Cherry-ish.

name: Instant Ice Pack
text: Cures burning and heals 1d4. Squeeze to activate.

name: Aloe Vera Gel
text: Cures burning. Green, sticky, cool.

name: Mini Bottle of Whiskey
text: +1 STR for 3 rooms. -1 DEX for 3 rooms. Airline size.

name: 5-Hour Energy Shot
text: Hasted for 2 rounds. Heals 1d4. Your heart sounds like a drum solo.

name: Potion of Stoneskin
text: Shielded for 3 rounds. Your skin feels like a countertop.

name: Potion of Mostly Invisible
text: Invisible for 2 rounds. Your shoes are still visible.

name: Bodybuilder Tonic
text: +2 STR for 3 rooms. Illegal in most sports.

name: Off-Brand Focus Pill
text: +2 INT for 3 rooms. You can hear the walls thinking.

name: Pheromone Cologne
text: +2 CHA for 3 rooms. Smells like a mall in 2004.

name: Cat Reflex Brew
text: +2 DEX for 3 rooms. You land on your feet. You also want to knock things off tables.

name: Iron Gut Tonic
text: +2 CON for 3 rooms. Tastes like a nail.

name: Aerosol Bug Spray
text: Thrown. 1d6 poison damage to the target. Not just for bugs anymore.

name: Pepper Spray
text: Thrown. Blinds the target for 2 rounds. Self-defense keychain edition.

name: Road Flare
text: Thrown. 1d6 fire damage and sets the target burning.

name: Novelty Smoke Bomb
text: Thrown. Blinds all enemies for 1 round. Purple smoke, from a magic shop.

name: Glitter Bomb
text: Thrown. Blinds all enemies for 2 rounds. The glitter is forever.

name: Water Balloon
text: Thrown. Cures burning on yourself if you drop it on your head. Otherwise mildly annoying.

name: Can of House Paint
text: Thrown. 1d4 damage and blinds the target for 1 round. Eggshell finish.

name: Bag of Marbles
text: Thrown. Slows all enemies for 2 rounds as they slip.

name: Bag of Metal Jacks
text: Thrown. 1d2 damage to every enemy. They step on them. You hear it.

name: Can of Spray Cheese
text: Heals 1d4. Can be sprayed in eyes: blinds the target 1 round.

name: Ghost Pepper Hot Sauce
text: Thrown. 1d4 fire damage and blinds the target 1 round. Also edible, technically.

name: Bundle of Bottle Rockets
text: Thrown. 1d4 fire damage to every enemy. Whistles first.

name: M-80 Firecracker
text: Thrown. 2d6 damage and stuns the target for 1 round. Illegal in 49 states.

name: Small Propane Tank
text: Thrown. 4d6 fire damage to every enemy. Hiss... wait for it.

name: Aerosol Can and a Lighter
text: Thrown. 2d6 fire damage and sets the target burning. Do not try this at home. Not home anymore.

name: Hard Lemonade Molotov
text: Thrown. 2d6 fire damage to every enemy. Raspberry flavor.

name: Fire Extinguisher
text: Thrown or sprayed. Stuns the target 1 round. Cures burning on yourself.

name: Stun Gun
text: Stuns the target for 2 rounds. One charge.

name: Bear Spray
text: Blinds and slows the target for 2 rounds. Rated for grizzlies. Not rated for this.

name: Can of Compressed Air
text: Sprayed upside down, it freezes. 1d6 cold damage and slows the target 1 round.

name: Bottle of Nail Polish Remover
text: Thrown. 1d6 fire damage if it hits something burning. Otherwise just smells awful.

name: Jug of Bleach
text: Thrown. 1d6 poison damage and blinds the target for 1 round.

name: Industrial Drain Cleaner
text: Thrown. 2d4 poison damage. Dissolves hair, grease, and faces.

name: Bottle of Ammonia
text: Thrown. Stuns the target for 1 round as it chokes.

name: Tube of Super Glue
text: Thrown. Slows the target for 3 rounds. Stuck to something.

name: Roll of Duct Tape
text: Heals 1d4 as a field dressing. Fixes armor. Fixes everything. Binds things together, which is the point.

name: Water Gun Full of Vinegar
text: Blinds the target for 1 round. Smells like salad.

name: Fishing Net
text: Thrown. The target is slowed for 3 rounds while it untangles.

name: Pair of Tethered Yo-Yos
text: Thrown. Slows the target for 2 rounds. Walk the dog. Walk the monster.

name: Prank Stink Bomb
text: Thrown. All enemies are confused for 1 round.

name: Whoopee Cushion
text: Thrown. The target is confused for 1 round. Somehow, it always works.

name: Party Popper
text: Thrown. Stuns the target for 1 round. Congratulations!

name: Confetti Cannon
text: Blinds all enemies for 1 round. Celebrate your survival.

name: Box of Snap Pops
text: Thrown. 1 damage to every enemy. Very, very startling.

name: Block of Dry Ice
text: Thrown. 1d8 cold damage and slows the target for 2 rounds.

name: Thermos of Liquid Nitrogen
text: Thrown. 3d6 cold damage and slows the target 2 rounds. From a science fair.

name: Car Battery
text: Thrown. 2d6 electric damage and stuns the target for 1 round. Heavy.

name: Box of Fluorescent Tubes
text: Thrown. 1d6 damage to every enemy. Burst into dust and noise.

name: Box of Mothballs
text: Thrown. 1d4 poison damage to every enemy. Smells like grandma's closet.

name: Paper Wasp Nest in a Bag
text: Thrown. 2d4 poison damage to every enemy and confuses them for 1 round. Do not drop.

name: Jar of Fire Ants
text: Thrown. 1d6 fire damage and the target burns for 3 rounds. They're angry.

name: Carton of Rotten Eggs
text: Thrown. Confuses the target for 2 rounds. A dozen, all bad.

name: Bottle of Holy Water, Probably
text: 2d6 damage to undead, thrown. Heals 1d4 if you drink it. Bought at a gift shop.

name: Plate of Deviled Eggs
text: Heals 2d4. Left out at a party for nine hours. Risky.

name: Slice of Wedding Cake
text: Heals 1d8+2. Fondant. Rich. Not yours.

name: Half a Birthday Cake
text: Heals 2d6. Says HAPPY BIRTH. Someone ate the DAY.

name: Church Potluck Casserole
text: Heals 3d4 and +1 CON for 3 rooms. Green bean. Crunchy onions on top.

name: Leftover Meatloaf
text: Heals 2d6. Ketchup glaze. Your aunt's recipe.

name: Grocery Store Rotisserie Chicken
text: Heals 3d6. Five dollars. Best deal left in the world.

name: Microwave Hot Pocket
text: Heals 1d8. Lava in the middle. Ice on the ends.

name: Fair Corn Dog
text: Heals 1d6+2. Comes on a stick, so you can also stab with it, once.

name: Funnel Cake
text: Heals 1d8. Powdered sugar gets everywhere. Hasted 1 round.

name: Cotton Candy
text: Heals 1d4. Hasted for 2 rounds. Pure sugar.

name: Giant Turkey Leg
text: Heals 3d4. +1 STR for 2 rooms. You feel medieval.

name: Stadium Nachos
text: Heals 2d4. Cheese is the color of a highlighter.

name: Soft Pretzel
text: Heals 1d6. Salt crystals the size of teeth.

name: Runner's Energy Gel
text: Heals 1d4. +1 to flee for 2 rooms. Salted caramel.

name: Fruit Cup in Heavy Syrup
text: Heals 1d6. A single cherry. Fight for it.

name: Chocolate Pudding Cup
text: Heals 1d4. From a hospital tray.

name: Lime Jell-O
text: Heals 1d4. Jiggles in a way that feels suspicious down here.

name: Instant Oatmeal Packet
text: Heals 1d6. Maple brown sugar. Eaten dry. Grim.

name: Uncooked Ramen Brick
text: Heals 1d4. Eaten like a cracker, with the seasoning packet sprinkled on top.

name: Crunchy Granola Bar
text: Heals 1d4. Shatters into a thousand pieces.

name: Meal Replacement Shake
text: Heals 2d4 and restores 1d4 MP. Vanilla, sort of.

name: Fortune Cookie
text: Heals 1. The fortune says something about the room you're in.

name: Mystery Meat Skewer
text: Heals 2d6. You do not ask. Chance to be poisoned.

name: Gas Station Sushi
text: Heals 2d6. Poisoned for 2 rounds. Worth it?

name: Expired Milk
text: Heals 1d4. Poisoned for 1 round. The date said 'best by'. It was not best.

name: Bar Pickled Egg
text: Heals 1d6. +1 CON for 2 rooms. From a jar that's been on the bar since 1987.

name: Bag of Ice
text: Cures burning. Heals 1d4. Melting.

name: Office First Aid Kit
text: Heals 2d6+2. OSHA-compliant.

name: Burn Cream
text: Cures burning and heals 1d6.

name: Saline Rinse
text: Cures blindness. Heals 1.

name: Bottle of Ibuprofen
text: Heals 1d6+2. Take two. Take four. Who's counting.

name: Non-Drowsy Allergy Pill
text: Cures poison. You feel drowsy anyway. Slowed 1 round.

name: EpiPen
text: Heals 2d8. Hasted 2 rounds. Your heart might explode. Out of your chest.

name: Nicotine Gum
text: +1 INT for 3 rooms. Chew and park.

name: Honey Throat Lozenge
text: Restores 1d4 MP. +1 CHA for 2 rooms. Your voice is honey.

name: Bottle of Mouthwash
text: +1 CHA for 3 rooms. Also 26% alcohol.

name: Can of Hairspray
text: Thrown with a lighter: 1d6 fire damage. Or +1 CHA for 2 rooms if you just use it.

name: Case of Energy Drinks
text: Hasted for 3 rounds, restores 1d4 MP. Twelve cans, eleven empty.

name: Melatonin Gummies
text: Heals 2d4 if used during rest. Otherwise slows you 1 round.

name: Shard of Mana Crystal
text: Restores 3d4 MP, scaled by floor. Hums faintly.

name: Glowing Mushroom
text: Restores 1d6 MP. Confused for 1 round. The walls are breathing.

name: Clump of Cave Moss
text: Heals 1d6. Tastes like a basement.

name: Monster Jerky
text: Heals 2d6. +1 STR for 2 rooms. You know where it came from.

name: Boss Steak
text: Heals 4d6. +2 CON for 5 rooms. The boss didn't need it anymore.

name: Vial of Troll Blood
text: Regenerating for 4 rounds. Green, thick, smells like feet.

name: Slime Jelly
text: Heals 1d8. Wobbles in your mouth. Cures poison, somehow.

name: Sponsor Snack Pack
text: Heals 2d4 and +1 to all stats for 1 room. Sponsored by someone who wants you to live.

name: Crawler Ration Bar
text: Heals 2d6. Provided by the dungeon. Tastes like cardboard and obligation.

name: Scattered, Smothered Hash Browns
text: Heals 2d6+2. Still warm in their styrofoam.

name: Bag of Pork Rinds
text: Heals 1d4. +1 STR for 2 rooms. Pure crunch.

name: Bag of Sunflower Seeds
text: Heals 1. Spit the shells at enemies. They hate that.

name: Wad of Bubble Gum
text: Thrown. Slows the target for 1 round. Already chewed. By you, hopefully.

name: Tube of Cake Frosting
text: Heals 1d6. Hasted 1 round. Straight from the tube.

name: Stack of Diner Pancakes
text: Heals 2d6. +1 CON for 3 rooms. Drowned in syrup.

name: Cup of Gas Station Chili
text: Heals 2d4. +1 to resist fire for 3 rooms. Burns going down. And later.

name: Slightly Brown Banana
text: Heals 1d6. Can also be dropped as a trap. It's funny.

name: Waxy Red Apple
text: Heals 1d4. Keeps one doctor away. There are no doctors.

name: Bag of Orange Slices
text: Heals 1d4. Halftime snacks. You feel like a kid again.

name: Chocolate Energy Bar
text: Heals 1d6. +1 DEX for 2 rooms.

name: Can of Creamed Corn
text: Heals 2d4. Nobody likes this. You need it.

name: Can of Spiced Ham
text: Heals 3d4. Shelf-stable since before you were born.

name: Tin of Little Sausages
text: Heals 1d8. Sits in a liquid you won't think about.

name: Melting Ice Cream Bar
text: Heals 1d6. Cures burning. Drips everywhere.

name: Rocket Popsicle
text: Heals 1d4. Cures burning. Red, white, blue, and brain freeze.

name: Coconut Water
text: Heals 1d6 and restores 1d4 MP. Tastes like sweaty grass.

name: Bottle of Kombucha
text: Cures poison. Slightly alcoholic. Very smug.

name: Protein Shake
text: +2 STR for 3 rooms. Chalky. Shaker ball rattles.

name: Scoop of Pre-Workout
text: Hasted for 3 rounds. +1 STR for 1 room. Your face tingles.

name: Communion Wafer
text: Heals 1. +1 to resist fear for 3 rooms. Stale.

name: Anointing Oil
text: Shielded for 2 rounds. Smells like frankincense.

name: Gauze and Tape
text: Heals 1d6+1. Wrapped tight.

name: Tourniquet
text: Heals 2d4 and stops bleeding. It's going to hurt.

name: Butterfly Stitches
text: Heals 1d4+1. Little paper bridges for your wounds.

name: Children's Grape Pain Reliever
text: Heals 1d4. Grape. Delicious. Measuring cup included.

name: Jar of Vapor Rub
text: Heals 1d4 and cures poison. Grandma's answer to everything.

name: Handful of Mustard Packets
text: Heals 1. Squeezed into eyes, blinds the target 1 round.

name: Squeeze Ketchup Bottle
text: Thrown. Blinds the target for 1 round. Looks like blood. Confuses things.

name: Bottle of Lotion
text: Spilled on the floor, slows every enemy for 1 round. Unscented.

name: Bottle of Baby Powder
text: Thrown. Blinds all enemies for 1 round. Talc everywhere.

name: Lane Oil Spray
text: Sprayed on the floor. Slows all enemies 2 rounds as they slide.

name: Plug-In Air Freshener
text: Cures poison gas effects in a room. Hawaiian Breeze.

name: Mylar Emergency Blanket
text: Shielded for 2 rounds. Crinkles loudly. Shiny.

name: Chemical Hand Warmers
text: +1 CON for 3 rooms. Cures slowed from cold.

name: Pack of Glow Sticks
text: Lights the room. Thrown: confuses the target 1 round with the raver vibes.

name: Pack of Cigarettes
text: +1 INT for 1 room. -1 CON for 1 room. Can be traded. Everyone wants these.

name: Stack of Scratch-Offs
text: Scratch one. 10% chance to find 50 gold. 90% chance to feel nothing.

name: Crystal-Clear Cola
text: Restores 2d4 MP. Discontinued in 1994. Somehow still fizzy.

name: Effervescent Cold Tablets
text: Heals 1d4 and cures stun. Plop plop fizz fizz.

name: Chamomile Tea Bag
text: Restores 1d4 MP. Cures confused. Steeped in a puddle, unfortunately.

name: Can of Yerba Mate
text: Hasted for 2 rounds. Restores 1d4 MP. Very earthy.

name: Bottle of Cooking Sherry
text: +1 CHA, -1 INT for 2 rooms. Salty wine. Desperate times.

name: Bag From a Box of Wine
text: Heals 1d6. -1 DEX for 2 rooms. Squeeze to dispense.

name: Cinnamon Whiskey Shot
text: +1 STR for 2 rooms. Resist fire? No. Breathe fire? Also no.

name: Growler of IPA
text: Heals 1d8. -1 INT for 2 rooms. Notes of grapefruit and arrogance.

name: Bottle of Champagne
text: Shake and pop. Stuns the target for 1 round. Then drink the rest: heal 1d4.

name: Sparkling Cider
text: Heals 1d6. For the kids' table. You're at the kids' table now.

name: Bloody Mary Mix
text: Heals 1d6. +1 CON for 2 rooms. Has a celery stick in it.

name: Bottle of Pickle Juice
text: Cures slowed. +1 CON for 2 rooms. Athletes swear by it.

name: Thermos of Bone Broth
text: Heals 2d6 and +1 CON for 3 rooms. Your wellness friend would be proud.

name: Monster-Sized Energy Drink
text: Hasted 4 rounds. Then slowed 2 rounds. There is a crash.

name: Kitchen Fire Extinguisher
text: Cures burning. Stuns the target for 1 round if sprayed in its face.

name: Spray Bottle of Weed Killer
text: 1d8 poison damage to plant monsters. 1d4 to everything else.

name: Box of Rat Poison
text: Mixed into food and thrown. Poisons the target for 4 rounds.

name: Roach Fogger
text: Poisons all enemies for 3 rounds. Leave the room for four hours. You can't.

name: Firework Mortar Tube
text: Thrown. 3d6 fire damage to every enemy. Also, very pretty.

name: Inert Novelty Grenade
text: Thrown. Confuses all enemies for 1 round. They think it's real.

name: Bag of Ball Bearings
text: Thrown on the floor. Slows all enemies for 2 rounds.

name: Can of Lighter Fluid
text: Thrown. 1d8 fire damage and sets the target burning for 3 rounds.

name: Bag of Self-Lighting Charcoal
text: Thrown, lit. 1d6 fire damage to every enemy.

name: Bucket of Sand
text: Thrown. Blinds the target for 2 rounds. Cures burning on you if you dump it on yourself.

name: Spoonful of Cinnamon
text: Thrown. Confuses the target for 2 rounds as it chokes.

name: Sport Jelly Beans
text: Hasted for 1 round, heals 1d4. Sold in running stores.

name: Astronaut Ice Cream
text: Heals 1d6. Freeze-dried. From a science museum gift shop.

name: Military MRE
text: Heals 3d6. +1 CON for 5 rooms. Includes a tiny bottle of hot sauce.

name: Frozen TV Dinner
text: Heals 2d6. The brownie is still frozen.

name: Kid's Cracker Lunch Kit
text: Heals 1d6+1. Build your own tiny sandwiches.

name: Honey Bear
text: Heals 1d6. Cures poison. Never goes bad. Never.

name: Bowl of Wedding Mints
text: Heals 1. +1 CHA for 2 rooms. Pastel. Dusty.

name: Fast Food Chalupa
text: Heals 2d4. Then poisoned 1 round. You knew.

name: Mozzarella Sticks
text: Heals 1d8. Cheese pulls three feet.

name: Bag of Squeaky Cheese Curds
text: Heals 1d6. They squeak against your teeth.

name: Whole Pizza in a Box
text: Heals 3d6. Large pepperoni. One slice missing.

name: Bucket of Fried Chicken
text: Heals 4d4. +1 STR for 3 rooms. Eight-piece, mixed.

name: Frosted Sugar Cookie
text: Heals 1d4+1. Shaped like a reindeer. Missing the head.

name: Roll of Friction Tape
text: Black cloth tape that smells like 1952. Wraps grips, binds things. Does nothing on its own.

name: Roll of Electrical Tape
text: Vinyl tape. Holds wires together, and lately holds civilization together too.

name: Coil of Nylon Rope
text: Twenty feet of yellow rope. Ties, binds, hangs. Choose your own adventure.

name: Bag of Zip Ties
text: A fistful of zip ties. The duct tape of people who own a label maker.

name: Box of Nails
text: Three-inch framing nails. Pointy end out, ideally.

name: Box of Thumbtacks
text: Brass thumbtacks from a bulletin board nobody will read again.

name: Coil of Barbed Wire
text: A coil of barbed wire. It's already drawn blood just being carried.

name: Handful of Broken Glass
text: Bottle glass in a sock-sized pile. Hold it by the safe edge, if you find one.

name: Pack of Razor Blades
text: Single-edge utility blades. Sharp in a way that feels personal.

name: Spool of Copper Wire
text: Stripped copper wire. Conducts electricity, and also bad decisions.

name: Oily Rags
text: Shop rags soaked in something flammable. A fire marshal's nightmare, a wick's dream.

name: Empty Bottle
text: A glass bottle with a little backwash. Somebody finished it in a hurry.

name: Disposable Lighter
text: A gas-station lighter with a wolf on it. Three clicks to light, every time.

name: Tube Sock
text: A single tube sock. Its partner is gone. Probably for the best.

name: Plastic Grocery Bag
text: THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU. A bag that outlived the store, the town and the planet.

name: Padlock
text: A heavy brass padlock with no key. Good weight. Good swing.

name: Pack of D Batteries
text: Four D batteries, mostly charged. Heavy little cylinders of potential.

name: Bike Inner Tube
text: A patched bicycle inner tube. Stretchy. Smells like a garage.

name: Stack of Old Magazines
text: Glossy magazines from before the end. Thick enough to stop a knife, if the knife is polite.

name: Flattened Cardboard Box
text: A flattened box. Padding, insulation, or a bed, depending on how your week is going.

name: Bungee Cord
text: A hooked bungee cord. Stretchy, tense, and always about to snap. Relatable.

name: Quart of Motor Oil
text: A quart of 10W-30. Slippery, flammable, and smells like your dad's car.

name: Caltrop Pouch
text: A sock full of tacks and nails. Thrown, it carpets the floor with bad news. 1d2 and slowed to everything that steps in.

name: Garage Bola
text: Rope and two heavy things. Thrown, it wraps the target's legs: 1d3 and slowed for 3 rounds.

name: Trip Wire Kit
text: Wire and a couple of anchors. Strung across a tile, the next thing through it falls flat (stunned for a round).

name: Glue Trap
text: Cardboard drenched in superglue. Whatever steps on it is stuck there for a while (slowed 2 rounds).

name: Duct-Tape Splint
text: Rags and duct tape, wrapped tight. Heals 1d6+2. Not a combat activity.
